newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' steady on restricted arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' steady on restricted arrivals.

text.p: Indian metals' prices held steady in a narrow price range on low industrial demand, dealers said.
Fresh offerings by state firms as well as importers remained low on reports that prices were stabilising in world markets.
Ready copper was unchanged at 11,700 rupees and nickel at 37,500 rupees. On Thursday copper was down by 50 rupees and nickel was down by 300 rupees.
Aluminium, zinc and lead prices were also unchanged.
